sharedFramebuffer.transport: host temp file bound into guest /tmp
sharedFramebuffer.generationRule: guest generation must strictly increase per window; FRAME_READY must match latest requested generation
sharedFramebuffer.coherence: MAP_SHARED page-cache visibility ordered by FRAME_READY; no per-frame MS_SYNC
sharedFramebuffer.frameRule: frameId must strictly increase for the active windowId/surfaceId/generation
sharedFramebuffer.resizeRule: new backing surface is allocated before the previous backing file is released
sharedFramebuffer.ownershipRule: single buffer: at most one FRAME_READY may be in flight per active Wine surface; guest must not modify backing bytes until matching FRAME_PRESENTED releases ownership
sharedFramebuffer.frameAckDemux: FRAME_PRESENTED is drained asynchronously by pProcessEvents or by the bounded SURFACE_AVAILABLE transaction demux. pProcessEvents may consume socket input that does not match the current Wine queue mask, but preserves pointer/key events in a bounded queue instead of dropping them, allowing FRAME_PRESENTED behind them to release the exact in-flight windowId/surfaceId/generation/frameId.
sharedFramebuffer.hostAckPoint: successful frame bytes are copied to host ARGB memory before FRAME_PRESENTED(status=0)
sharedFramebuffer.coalescingRule: if Wine flushes while a frame is still in flight, the driver leaves the shared mmap untouched and returns FALSE so win32u retains dirty bounds; the normal Wine flush/idle path retries after the matching surface-qualified FRAME_PRESENTED releases ownership
sharedFramebuffer.frameAckIdentityRule: FRAME_PRESENTED must exactly match windowId, surfaceId, generation and frameId of the in-flight FRAME_READY
sharedFramebuffer.lateAckRule: ACK from a replaced/destroyed surface cannot release ownership of a newer surface even when frameId is reused
sharedFramebuffer.inputMaskRule: Pointer/key events received while the current pProcessEvents mask excludes them are retained in the bounded host-event queue. Eligible events may be selected past deferred events, matching Wine queue-mask semantics; queue overflow or an unexpected transaction event fails the bridge closed.
sharedFramebuffer.frameFailureRule: FRAME_PRESENTED with non-zero status, wrong active identity or wrong in-flight frame is fatal for the current bridge session; the guest closes the transport instead of silently releasing ownership and continuing.
sharedFramebuffer.bridgeReadinessRule: Bridge readiness is read through the driver mutex and requires both pocketpc_bridge_ready and a non-negative transport fd. Callbacks re-check readiness under the mutex immediately before IPC.
sharedFramebuffer.frameAckMaskRule: FRAME_PRESENTED is control-plane ownership traffic and remains eligible for pProcessEvents under every Wine queue mask. Pointer/key/window-command events that are not eligible for the current mask are retained in the bounded host-event queue.
sharedFramebuffer.surfacePublishFailureRule: After SURFACE_AVAILABLE has been accepted, failure to publish the corresponding guest surface registry entry is fatal to the current bridge session because host and guest would disagree about the active surface generation.

rules: exactly one flag must be set
AFTER_WINDOW requires non-zero insertAfterWindowId different from windowId

wineBinding.reusePolicy: signature/behavior reference only; do not reuse wineandroid.drv binary or Java/JNI ABI

zOrder.postSendFailureRule: After WINDOW_CREATE/WINDOW_GEOMETRY/WINDOW_DESTROY is successfully sent, any failure to record the corresponding local lifecycle transition invalidates the bridge connection. Pre-send local validation failures do not tear down the session.

pointer.verticalScroll: Windows WHEEL_DELTA units; zero unless action=SCROLL
pointer.modifiers: bitmask from inputSemantics.modifiers; unknown bits invalid

keyboard.scanCode: Win32 scan code; bit 0x100 marks extended key
keyboard.repeatCount: 0 means one event for DOWN/UP; REPEAT uses max(1, repeatCount)
keyboard.modifiers: bitmask from inputSemantics.modifiers; unknown bits invalid

windowCommands.transactionRule: commands may be queued while SURFACE_AVAILABLE/FRAME_PRESENTED transactions are pending

transport.establishedSessionReadTimeout: disabled (blocking read); established desktop idleness must not terminate the bridge
transport.capabilityNegotiation: guest HELLO advertises only host-offered capabilities that are implemented by the guest; production authentication requires WINDOW_SURFACE|POINTER|KEYBOARD|FRAME_ACK and rejects incomplete baselines

controlledWindowsAttempt.targetMaterialization: content:// SAF target is copied into /home/pocket/windows-targets through a verified host file, SHA-256 named, bounded and no-follow checked
controlledWindowsAttempt.executionChain: phase 1: PRoot -> fixed /bin/sh positional exec -> Box64/Wine reg.exe add Graphics=pocketpc without Display Bridge; phase 2 only after exit=0: authenticated Display Bridge -> PRoot -> fixed /bin/sh positional exec -> Box64/Wine -> materialized EXE/MSI
controlledWindowsAttempt.shellSafety: dynamic Box64/Wine/target values are positional arguments and are never interpolated into shell source
controlledWindowsAttempt.evidenceRule: all required smoke evidence must come from one runtime/tool/layer identity; application compatibility remains UNVALIDATED after a mere attempt
controlledWindowsAttempt.desktopRule: continuous RuntimeDisplaySessionController publishes compositor windows through RuntimeDesktopBridge
controlledWindowsAttempt.graphicsRoute: controlled app attempts require the currently discovered dxvk layer and set WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d11=n;dxgi=n, matching the validated D3D11/Present smoke route
controlledWindowsAttempt.wineDriverGate: attempt remains blocked until WINE_POCKETPC_WINDOW_SMOKE records an identity-bound round trip proving winepocketpc.drv window creation, GDI pixels, pointer/key input and window destruction through the Android broker
controlledWindowsAttempt.evidenceNamespace: runtime-probe-evidence-v8; earlier evidence namespace is intentionally not reused
controlledWindowsAttempt.graphicsDriverSelection: graphics configuration has its own ProotInvocationPlan and must pass before RuntimeDisplayExecutionController starts, preventing a configuration utility from authenticating as the application display peer
controlledWindowsAttempt.graphicsDriverEvidence: WINE_POCKETPC_WINDOW_SMOKE evidence is recorded only when output includes wine_graphics_driver_config=pocketpc and the identity-bound window/frame/input round trip passes

checkedContracts: PE dllmain versus #pragma makedep unix source classification

multiProcessDisplay.windowIdentity: guest windowId = (positive 31-bit Linux PID namespace << 32) | monotonic 32-bit local window counter
multiProcessDisplay.desktopRouting: RuntimeDesktopBridge keeps concurrent bindings, maps every windowId to one owning binding, and routes window commands, pointer events and keyboard events to that owner
multiProcessDisplay.sessionLifecycle: RuntimeDisplayExecutionController requires the first authenticated peer, then continues accepting authenticated peers until the launched PRoot/Wine session exits
multiProcessDisplay.zOrderMerge: per-peer compositor order is merged; topmost windows stay above non-topmost windows and global zIndex is reassigned
multiProcessDisplay.evidence: source/unit/native smoke prepared; CI/physical execution remains false until a runner/device executes it
multiProcessDisplay.launcherChildHandoff: if the supervised root/launcher exits before a first graphical peer, wait up to 5000 ms for a child peer; after authentication keep the host alive while any peer session remains active, then require 5000 ms of peer quiescence before teardown
multiProcessDisplay.rootProcessLimitation: family supervision is now implemented statically, but no Android physical execution has yet proven /proc discovery, signals, launcher handoff or orphan cleanup

processFamilySupervision.discovery: scan /proc while the supervised root is alive; retain PID+startTimeTicks identities and recursively discover descendants
processFamilySupervision.pidReuseSafety: a member is acted on only when its current /proc startTimeTicks still matches the observed identity
processFamilySupervision.launcherExit: retain an empty family for 5000 ms after root exit so a child PID embedded in a namespaced windowId can attach during display handoff
processFamilySupervision.displayAssociation: windowId high 32 bits carry the positive Wine PID namespace; authenticated display windows associate that PID with the active supervised family
processFamilySupervision.termination: signal descendants deepest-first with SIGTERM/SIGKILL and terminate the registered root last
processFamilySupervision.taskManager: show family process count, aggregate RSS/threads, family PIDs and family-wide terminate controls
